output.title: GA UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer feature may affect the cert-manager controller in use
output.content: This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 (found through label, flux-helmrelease, argocd-application, helm-annotation and helmfile sources) and its manifests use cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate. A cert-manager feature moving to GA therefore reaches this deployment. The release note only says that `UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer` is promoted to GA (#7735). It does not explain what the feature changes or how it affects existing resources. None of the 9 values keys shown set a feature-gate key, so the operator should read PR #7735 to see how the GA behavior treats finalizers on existing Certificate and related resources before upgrading.
